title: Blogger Canonical Diagnostics Catalog
description: Standard catalogue of diagnostic codes, severities, and validation rules for Blogger template compilers and linters.

BX1003.name: PROHIBITED_SET_TAG
BX1003.message: <b:set> is hallucinated; Blogger uses <b:with value='...' var='...'>.

BX1004.name: PROHIBITED_VAR_TAG
BX1004.message: <b:var> is hallucinated; Blogger uses <b:with value='...' var='...'>.

BX1005.name: PROHIBITED_LET_TAG
BX1005.message: <b:let> is hallucinated; Blogger uses <b:with value='...' var='...'>.

BX1007.name: PROHIBITED_CHOOSE_TAG
BX1007.message: <b:choose> is XSL/JSTL; Blogger uses <b:switch var='...'> or <b:if>.

BX1013.name: PROHIBITED_CLOSING_DELIMITER
BX1013.message: <b:eval> is canonically self-closing (<b:eval/>). The Blogger compiler tolerates closing tags and ignores inner content, but non-self-closing tags violate template conventions.

BX1017.name: PROHIBITED_JS_METHOD
BX1017.message: JavaScript method calls are invalid in Blogger expressions. Use native operators and helpers.

BX1018.name: PROHIBITED_JS_OPERATOR
BX1018.message: Strict equality (===, !==) is not supported in Blogger expressions; use == or !=.

BX1019.name: PROHIBITED_LAMBDA_DATA_PREFIX
BX1019.message: Using 'data:' prefix on lambda iterator properties is redundant. The Blogger runtime tolerates it, but accessing iterator properties directly (p.prop) is the canonical practice.

BX1020.name: INVALID_NULL_LITERAL
BX1020.message: Literal 'null' does not exist in Blogger expressions and causes a fatal compilation abort.

BX1021.name: EXPRESSION_TOKEN_QUOTA_EXCEEDED
BX1021.message: Expression exceeds the 40-token compiler ceiling and will abort evaluation in production.

BX1023.name: PROHIBITED_NESTING
BX1023.message: Invalid parent-child nesting for directive in Blogger XML hierarchy.

BX1024.name: DEPRECATED_ATTRIBUTE
BX1024.message: Directive attribute is deprecated in Layouts v3. Blogger ignores and strips this attribute upon saving without aborting template compilation.

BX1025.name: UNKNOWN_DIRECTIVE
BX1025.message: Unknown directive in Blogger 'b:' XML namespace.

BX1026.name: PROHIBITED_DATE_RELATIONAL_COMPARISON
BX1026.message: Direct relational comparison (<, >, <=, >=) on Date objects is not supported in Blogger expressions. Format the date to string or use date.iso8601.

BX1027.name: DIRECT_PARAMETERIZED_MESSAGE_INVOCATION
BX1027.message: Parameterized message tokens cannot be evaluated via direct tag invocation (<data:messages.key/>) and output raw un-interpolated template strings. Use <b:message name='...'> with child <b:param> tags.

BX1028.name: PLURAL_MESSAGE_PARAM_MISSING_NAME
BX1028.message: Pluralized ICU messages require the 'name' attribute on child <b:param> tags matching the plural identifier (e.g. <b:param name='numComments' value='...'/>); omitting 'name' aborts template compilation.

BX1029.name: INLINE_CONCATENATED_MESSAGE_PARAMS
BX1029.message: Multiple <b:param> tags concatenated inline without intervening whitespace (<b:param .../><b:param .../>) cause Blogger runtime error 'Invalid parameters for message'. Sibling <b:param> tags must be separated by whitespace or placed on separate lines.

BX1030.name: PROHIBITED_UNARY_EXPRESSION_NEGATION
BX1030.message: Unary prefix '-' cannot be applied to parenthesized compound expressions (e.g. -(a - b)) and triggers 'Invalid expression' compiler error. Blogger expression engine only permits unary negation on simple literals or variables.

BX1031.name: NON_OBJECT_INCLUDE_DATA_PAYLOAD
BX1031.message: The 'data' attribute of <b:include> strictly requires an object reference or object literal { ... }; passing primitive scalars (string, number, boolean) aborts execution with runtime error 'Error during evaluation of <name>'.

BX1032.name: PROHIBITED_BRACKET_INDEXING_IN_DATA_TAG
BX1032.message: Direct bracket indexing (e.g. <data:items[0]/>) is forbidden in <data:...> tags and causes template compilation error. Use <b:eval expr='data:items[0]'/> to index collections.

BX1033.name: DUPLICATE_ELEMENT_ID
BX1033.message: Duplicate element identifier detected. Blogger requires all <b:section> and <b:widget> elements to have unique 'id' attributes across the template.

BX1034.name: WIDGET_OUTSIDE_SECTION
BX1034.message: <b:widget> must be placed inside a <b:section>. Widgets placed directly under <body> or outside sections are rejected by Blogger.

BX1035.name: NESTED_SECTION
BX1035.message: Nested <b:section> detected. Blogger does not allow a <b:section> inside another <b:section>.

BX1036.name: DUPLICATE_INCLUDABLE_ID
BX1036.message: Duplicate includable identifier inside container. Includable 'id' attributes must be unique within their parent <b:widget> or <b:defaultmarkup> block.

BX1037.name: UNRESOLVED_INCLUSION
BX1037.message: Unresolved inclusion: referenced includable does not exist in the current widget, defaultmarkups, or global server inclusions.

BX1038.name: STRING_BOOLEAN_IN_EXPRESSION
BX1038.message: Comparing against a quoted boolean string literal ('true' / 'false') in expression. Use boolean literals true or false directly.

BX1039.name: EMPTY_REQUIRED_ATTRIBUTE
BX1039.message: Required directive attribute value cannot be empty.

BX1040.name: INVALID_VARIABLE_TYPE_ATTRIBUTE
BX1040.message: Attribute is not supported for the declared <Variable> type.

BX1041.name: MISMATCHED_OR_UNCLOSED_TAG
BX1041.message: XML tag is mismatched or remains unclosed in the template structure.

BX1042.name: DISALLOWED_EXPRESSION_ATTRIBUTE
BX1042.message: Directive attribute does not allow dynamic expressions ('expr:').

BX1043.name: DISALLOWED_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE
BX1043.message: Directive attribute value is not in the set of allowed canonical values.

BX1044.name: FATAL_OPERATOR_ARITY
BX1044.message: Invoking operator with fatal arity (such as eq() with fewer than 2 arguments or -() with 0 arguments) triggers an unhandled backend crash (HTTP 500) on Blogger template engine.

BX1045.name: EXPRESSION_TOKEN_QUOTA_APPROACHING
BX1045.message: Expression token count is approaching the 40-token compiler ceiling.

BX1046.name: NON_STANDARD_BRACED_COLLECTION
BX1046.message: Using curly braces '{ ... }' for array/set collections is non-standard in Blogger. Use bracket notation '[ ... ]' instead to ensure future compatibility.
